is: Twenty-three use-case modules, one per verb or concern (verify lives in check, `zaf do` in actions, the scheduler's edge in schedule, the zaf home's project list in projects, a version's release folder in release), each taking a query or command over port traits and returning a flat result, the larger ones split into submodules.
conventions: A verb that needs processes no port covers defines its own narrow trait with a fake beside it (doctor's Commands, doctor/fake.rs)
Prompts and settings come from zaf/assets/ via include_str!; .zaf/roles/keeper.md and team.md override the keeper prompt and team brief at runtime

fs.name: actions/
fs.role: `zaf do`: the action file format and its metadata (metadata.rs), the project and machine tiers (resolve.rs), the one runner every caller uses (run.rs), who may run or read an action by its mode (caller.rs), the slice environment ZAF_BASE, ZAF_SLICE, ZAF_PR and ZAF_TASK_TITLE (slice_env.rs), the slice records slice-open and slice-pr hand back (records.rs), and the Team Phases with derive_phase, the pure rule table that guards the merge path (phase.rs; phase/gather.rs reads what it decides on, phase/live.rs which phase runs are live)

fs.name: ask/
fs.role: `zaf ask`: keeper questions up the [ask] ladder, quote-verified (a failed citation check is reported, exit 2), logged to .zaf/asklog.jsonl

fs.name: asklog/
fs.role: `zaf asklog`: top cited pages, recurring questions, gaps

fs.name: begin.rs
fs.role: `zaf begin --version <v>`: refused with one sentence inside an instance (SignGuard's process ancestry) and where there is no terminal; else the phase due (phase_due) or, with none due, the version's open epics, each with `zaf epic sign <id>` while not signed; the place the begin run, sign and `--phase` tasks extend

fs.name: begin/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: board.rs
fs.role: `zaf board` ready, claim, report, question, ruling

fs.name: board/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: brief/
fs.role: `zaf brief`: task context pack (ticket, pages, a ## Rulings section with the questions and rulings on the task, nodes chain, style, interface page; for a resumed phase with a pull request also its diff, the findings at its head and the hand-off; for an on-fail phase, why.rs's ## Why this run: the failed phase, its exit code and meaning, its failed checks, the last lines of its run, and every ruling since the last model run)

fs.name: changes.rs
fs.role: `zaf changes`: diff stat, hunks on request

fs.name: changes/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: check/
fs.role: `zaf check` and `zaf verify`

fs.name: doctor.rs
fs.role: `zaf doctor`: tool versions (gh not needed when neither the board nor the forge is on GitHub), folders, design index, profile logins and pack, and what the board's and the forge's backends answer (a Forgejo instance and token)

fs.name: doctor/
fs.role: actions.rs (every action of either tier with its validity and mode), needed.rs (each action name the project needs and the tier that provides it), phases.rs (each action a [phases] list names), hub.rs (the hub service line), fake.rs (Commands fake) and tests.rs

fs.name: epic.rs
fs.role: zaf epic list|sign|file: the open epics with their stage, the signature refused when an instance runs above this process (process ancestry against the run folders), and an epic of a version filed under a `Release: <version>` first line, an open one of that version and title handed back instead

fs.name: epic/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: forge.rs
fs.role: `zaf forge` open, merge, checks, head, log: input checked, one Forge port call each; the failed log cut to its last 80 lines

fs.name: forge/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: guard.rs
fs.role: `zaf guard`: weekly budget level to .zaf/guard.json

fs.name: guard/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: hub.rs
fs.role: `zaf hub`: the Engineer's live view; it only reads and costs no model turns

fs.name: hub/
fs.role: what gathers the state, draws the frame, serves the page on the LAN and admits its keyed controls

fs.name: init.rs
fs.role: the manifest questions `zaf setup` asks: minimal manifest from four questions (a fifth, forge url, for a non-GitHub origin, which writes Forgejo kinds)

fs.name: init/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: profile/
fs.role: `zaf profile init`: deterministic hermetic Claude homes, pack installed via claude plugin commands; stamp.rs the .zaf-stamp.json saying what a profile was made from

fs.name: projects.rs
fs.role: the zaf home's projects.toml: every folder a verb has run in or `zaf setup` has set up

fs.name: projects/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: release.rs
fs.role: ReleaseFolder: a version's release folder from `[release] folder`, its objectives document (objectives.md, else scope.md) and design.md; phase_due, the phase due for a version (PhaseDue: objectives, design or nothing, with any malformed block) from the folder and the board's epics; release_versions and due_releases, each release folder the pattern matches whose objectives or design are due (a released version, as is_released reads it from the `[release] tag` pattern and the version control, and a folder with a signoff.md left out)

fs.name: release/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: report.rs
fs.role: `zaf report`: tokens and dollars per model from transcripts

fs.name: report/
fs.role: report's prices, transcript parser, SQLite ledger, per-epic rows and golden fixtures

fs.name: schedule.rs
fs.role: the scheduler's edge around the pure core: every question the scheduler raises, each with a marker it reads back (ask), the phase run folder's one writer and reader (record), the ports read into each open ticket's facts (gather), the one gate every phase start passes and the tick's phase steps over the placement (tick), the placement as the JSON dry run shows it (shadow), the state labels set from each ticket's place before any start (labels), the trace line every real tick leaves with its moves (trace, pure) and the file that keeps it 14 days (ticks); the scheduler that stays up (`zaf spawn --watch`): its loop (scheduler, pure behind a Host), its lock (lock), the requests for a tick (request) and the look at its own binary (binary)

fs.name: schedule/
fs.role: the edge modules schedule.rs names, one file each

fs.name: setup.rs
fs.role: `zaf setup`: lay out .zaf/, fetch design, worksheet for missing tools

fs.name: setup/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: slice.rs
fs.role: `zaf slice` open, pr, merge, drop on a board-resolved target

fs.name: slice/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: spawn/
fs.role: `zaf spawn --once`: one spawner tick

fs.name: status.rs
fs.role: `zaf status`: epics with their stage, a line per release whose objectives or design are due, board, instances, slots, guard on one screen; with `[phases]`, ready is the core's lane and a waiting line names what each ticket waits on

fs.name: status/
fs.role: tests.rs

fs.name: update.rs
fs.role: zaf update: the newest zaf-v* release read live, its archive checked by sha256, probed with --version, renamed over the running binary

fs.name: update/
fs.role: tests.rs

notes: .zaf/ file names are constants repeated per module (RUNS_DIR in brief, spawn and adapters::gate; asklog.jsonl in ask and setup)
.zaf/local.toml is read by guard ([budget]) and report (prices) as well as by the manifest, which takes only [spawn] slots and [gate] slot from it
Only lean and build profiles ship settings; design and review profiles get none from profile init
